title: Luxurious Townhouse Nashville
description:
Experience Nashville like a local in this charming 3-bedroom townhome. 3 bedroom each with its own bathroom attached for added privacy. A great place to call homebase while you're away.

11 minutes from Nashville airport

We hope you enjoy your stay.

The space
Modern townhouse centrally located in Nashville Tennesee. Beautiful home away from home whether you are vacationing or need a quick get away. This beautiful home has 3 spacious bedrooms each with is own attached full bathroom. I hope you enjoy your stay!

Guest access
Full access to entire home.

Other things to note
Please park in designated parking spots or in visitor parking. Parking is free.
